paper.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking

result.summary: 本文提出 Quiet-STaR，将 STaR 从问答数据集推广到任意文本，让语言模型在每个 token 处生成内部理由以解释后续文本，从而提升预测能力 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。方法包含并行理由生成、混合头以及基于 REINFORCE 的理由优化三个步骤 [S4.SS1.p1]。在 Mistral 7B 上使用 OpenWebMath 和 C4 继续预训练后，模型在 GSM8K 和 CommonsenseQA 上取得零样本提升，且提升随内部思考 token 数增加而增大 [S1.p3][S5.SS1.p1]。作者认为这标志着语言模型能够以更通用、可扩展的方式学习推理 [S7.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：既然推理隐含在所有文本中，能否利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理，而不是依赖精心策划的问答数据集 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。作者指出，已有让语言模型从自身推理中学习的方法主要聚焦于解决单个任务或预定义任务集合，依赖精心策划的数据集提供推理任务甚至推理本身 [S1.p1]。因此，本文希望将 STaR 推广到从大规模互联网文本语料中学习推理，使模型能从语言中存在的多样任务中学习 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We instead ask, if reasoning is implicit in all text, why shouldn’t we leverage the task of language modeling to teach reasoning?
methods for allowing LMs to learn from their reasoning (e.g.,) have focused on solving individual tasks or predefined sets of tasks (e.g.,).

Thus, we extend STaR – instead of the LM learning to reason on particular tasks like mathematical QA, we train an LM to generate reasoning that helps it infer future text from a large internet text corpus.
As a result, we allow the LM to learn from the diverse tasks present in language.

method.text: Quiet-STaR 在每对观测 token 之间引入辅助的“理由”变量，目标是优化语言模型生成中间思考，使其能更好地预测剩余序列 [S3.p1]。算法分三步：在输入序列的 n 个 token 处并行生成 r 个长度为 t 的理由，并插入可学习的思考开始/结束 token [S4.SS1.p1]；用混合头（浅层 MLP）输出权重，决定后理由预测 logits 与基础语言模型 logits 的混合程度 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS3.p1]；用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成参数，并采用教师强制技巧把思考后多个 token 的预测纳入损失 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: In this work, we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence.
In parallel across $n$ tokens $x_{i}$ in an input sequence $x_{0:n}$, we generate $r$ rationales of length $t$: $c_{i}=(c_{i1},\dots,c_{it})$, resulting in $n\times r$ rationale candidates.
We insert learned <| startofthought |> and <| endofthought |> tokens to mark each rationale’s start and end.

we train a ”mixing head” – a shallow MLP producing a weight determining how much the post-rationale next-token predicted logits should be incorporated compared to the base language model predicted logits.
We use REINFORCE to provide a learning signal to rationales based on their impact on future-token prediction.
Instead, we use the parallel attention mask to compute the log probabilities of the true next tokens, applying teacher forcing by assuming the model selected the correct next ground-truth token

experiments.text: 所有实验均从 Mistral 7B 基础版本开始 [S5.p1]。大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，作者预期该语料包含更高密度的受益于推理的 token [S5.p2]；同时也在 C4 上评估，C4 是更广泛使用的、文本更多样的预训练语料 [S5.p2]。评估指标包括 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 上的零样本推理能力，以及思考 token 的影响分布 [S5.p1]。C4 评估使用 16 个思考 token 和 4 个真实 token 前瞻，其余设置相同 [S5.SS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
We also evaluate Quiet-STaR on C4, a widely used LM pretraining corpus with more diverse text, and again show significant albeit smaller benefits.

We evaluate 1) whether Quiet-STaR improves a language model’s ability to directly predict answers in datasets that require reasoning; and, 2) the distribution of impacts resulting from thinking tokens.
Specifically, for our C4 evaluation, we train Mistral 7B with 16 thought tokens and 4 true tokens ahead and otherwise the same setup.

findings.text: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上相比基础语言模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且提升随理由 token 数增加而持续增大 [S5.SS1.p1]。在 C4 上训练也带来提升，但幅度较小：GSM8K 从 5.9% 到 8.1%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 到 42.6% [S5.SS1.p2]。与 pause token 微调相比，后者在 CommonsenseQA 上从 26.9% 提升到 28.8%，在 GSM8K 上反而损害性能，且多数评估任务中额外思考 token 有害 [S5.SS1.p3]。在零样本思维链设置下，Quiet-STaR 使 8 样本多数投票准确率从 40.6% 提升到 47.7%（GSM8K 128 个测试样本）[S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
Similarly, on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model, and once again, performance scales with the length of the rationales generated during Quiet-STaR training.
We find that training with Quiet-STaR on C4 also improves performance on GSM8K ( $5.9\%\rightarrow 8.1\%$) and CommonsenseQA ( $36.3\%\rightarrow 42.6\%$) but by a smaller margin.

Their results indicate that pause token fine-tuning also provides minor gains over the base model on CommonsenseQA, they observed an improvement from 26.9% to 28.8%; on GSM8K, found that pause token fine-tuning harms performance.
Moreover, on both tasks (and the majority of their evaluated tasks), they observed that additional thought tokens harmed performance.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR, as evaluated on a sample of 128 GSM8K test items.

limitations.text: 作者承认，为解决元学习挑战而做了某些简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术是否在模型从头训练时也有效 [S6.p1]。目前只将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。Quiet-STaR 带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前要生成许多 token [S6.p2]。当前实现不支持动态预测何时生成或结束理由 [S6.p2]。此外，无法知道模型用语言表达的推理是否准确代表其内部处理（忠实性），且若模型发现有害或有偏见的推理模式有用，也没有防护措施 [Sx1.p1]。

evidence.quote: For example, it would be valuable to understand whether these techniques work when a model is trained from scratch.
We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
For example, it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model (i.e., faithfulness).
In addition, regardless of faithfulness, there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
